About Us Guided by Choice. Delivered with Care.

Serenity Mode is a Melbourne NDIS provider built on fairness, dignity and human rights — delivering person-centred care for participants and their families.

We aim to provide best-practice care that raises our clients to the peak of their ability, so they can live in harmony within the wider community.

Our Story | Serenity Mode

Guided by Choice.
Delivered with Care.

At Serenity Mode, we uphold the principles of fairness, dignity and human rights. Our services operate within a legislative framework and adhere to the national community care standards set by the Australian Government.

We are committed to providing a safe and respectful environment for every client — one that is free from discrimination, abuse, neglect and exploitation.

A safe environment, free from:
DiscriminationAbuseNeglectExploitation Sexual HarmEmotional HarmFinancial HarmPhysical Harm

Fair & Transparent Complaints

Our clients have access to a fair, transparent and accessible system for lodging complaints and reporting any breaches of their rights.

Contact Us → Complaints Management
Our Approach

A Choice and Control Model of Care

Our services follow a Choice and Control model, allowing clients to choose supports tailored to their individual needs and preferences.

  • Supports tailored to each person's individual needs and preferences
  • Greater autonomy and flexibility for clients and their families
  • Help accessing NDIS and mental health support programs and resources

What Drives Us

Our Vision & Mission

The purpose behind every support we provide and every participant we walk alongside.

01
Vision

Enhancing every participant's life journey, navigating complexity with dignity and optimism.

02
Mission

Providing accessible, person-centred care and supports to participants with integrity, compassion, inclusivity and courage.

Core Values

The Values Behind
Everything We Do.

Four principles guide how we care for participants, support our team and serve our community.

Inclusivity

We create an environment where every individual in our community feels valued, accepted and respected.

Integrity

We are committed to honesty, transparency and ethical decision-making, always acting in the best interests of our clients, employees and the community.

Compassion

We deliver our services with kindness and understanding, with a deep commitment to the wellbeing of every participant.

Courage

We stand up for what is right, advocate for those in our care and face challenges with confidence and compassion. We are committed to making a difference, even when it's hard.

Our Commitment

Safe, Inclusive & Respectful for Everyone

We are steadfast in our commitment to creating a safe, inclusive and respectful environment for all — especially for the vulnerable, children and young people.

We actively support every individual we engage with, embracing and celebrating diversity across race, ability, culture, sexuality and gender identity.

Fairness & DignityHuman rights at the centre of every service
